name: Foresight Sports
known_for: Highest accuracy photometric cameras in golf
Used by top PGA Tour pros, club fitters, and teachers worldwide
FSX software ecosystem and high-speed impact video
notable_clients_canada: Commercial indoor venues across Toronto, Vancouver, Calgary, and Montreal
brand_description_short: Foresight Sports builds the most accurate photometric launch monitors in golf. Founded in 2010, their multi-camera systems are the industry benchmark.
editor_verdict: Best-in-class accuracy for indoor golf simulators. Zero calibration distance needed, making Foresight the top choice for Canadian garage and basement builds.

name: SkyTrak
known_for: Pioneering affordable consumer home launch monitors
SkyTrak+ hybrid dual-camera and radar tracking engine
Wide third-party software integration including GSPro and E6 Connect
notable_clients_canada: Thousands of Canadian home garage & basement simulator owners
Regional golf academies and high school golf programs
brand_description_short: SkyTrak revolutionized consumer indoor golf simulation by bringing tour-proven photometric technology down to accessible price points.
editor_verdict: The undisputed value king for Canadian golfers looking to build a high-performance home simulator setup under $5,000 CAD.

name: Bushnell Golf
known_for: World leader in golf laser rangefinders and GPS units
Partnering with Foresight Sports for triscopic camera launch monitors
Exceptional build quality and extensive Canadian dealer distribution
notable_clients_canada: Pro shops and golf retailers across every Canadian province
Avid amateur players building home bays
brand_description_short: Bushnell Golf brings decades of distance measurement authority to home simulation with hardware powered by Foresight camera technology.
editor_verdict: Offers Foresight GC3 camera precision at a lower initial hardware price point, making it a compelling option for smart Canadian buyers.

name: Uneekor
hq: Irvine, California, USA / Seoul, South Korea
known_for: Overhead high-speed camera systems with OPTIX club impact video
Seamless left and right handed play without moving hardware
Powerful VIEW and Refine software platform
notable_clients_canada: Custom simulator design firms across Ontario and Western Canada
brand_description_short: Uneekor specializes in overhead mounted camera launch monitors designed for clean floor space and instantaneous club impact replay.
editor_verdict: The premier overhead option for Canadian homeowners who want a clean floor space and instant slow-motion video of their club striking the ball.

name: Full Swing Golf
known_for: Official simulator partner of the PGA Tour and TGL
Endorsed and used by Tiger Woods and Jon Rahm
Full Swing KIT portable radar launch monitor
notable_clients_canada: Luxury private residences in Toronto, Vancouver, and Muskoka
brand_description_short: Full Swing is an industry leader in luxury simulator enclosures and radar-camera fusion tracking, backed by endorsement from Tiger Woods.
editor_verdict: Great option for buyers with deep room dimensions (16+ ft) who want radar data paired with built-in high-definition video capture.

name: TrackMan
known_for: The global benchmark for outdoor Doppler radar tracking
Used on broadcast television for PGA Tour ball flight tracking
notable_clients_canada: Top private Canadian golf clubs (Hamilton G&CC, Capilano, St. George's)
University golf teams and national fitting centers
brand_description_short: TrackMan is the world leader in radar-based golf ball tracking technology, dominant on tour and across premier golf facilities worldwide.
editor_verdict: Unmatched for outdoor range use. Indoors, ensure you have sufficient ball flight distance (16–18ft room length) or opt for TrackMan iO.
